europe_now.title: Poland Issues Preparedness Guidance for Potential Air Attacks
europe_now.summary: Polish authorities have published official instructions detailing how citizens should respond to potential air raids. The advisory highlights ongoing security concerns tied to neighboring regional threats.

sources.headline: Poland issues guidance on responding to air attacks and warns of Russia threat

europe_now.title: EU Faces Sanctions Evasion Challenges via Russian Shadow Fleet
europe_now.summary: European Union member states are encountering renewed enforcement hurdles as shadow fleet oil tankers revert to Russian flags. This shift underscores persistent vulnerabilities in maintaining comprehensive trade restrictions.

sources.headline: Shadow fleet tankers flock back to being flagged as Russian, creating more headaches for EU states

top_stories.title: Pope Leo XIV Begins State Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has commenced an official state visit to France with engagements in Paris, including an address at the Élysée presidential palace. During his remarks, he touched upon themes ranging from diplomacy and secularism to artificial intelligence.

sources.headline: Pope warns against 'losing humanity' to AI machines

top_stories.title: Ukraine Seeks Expanded Defense Capabilities
top_stories.summary: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warned that a significant funding gap could leave the country short of necessary military equipment early next year. Meanwhile, discussions continue regarding defense production licenses and technological innovations on the battlefield.
